facts.fact: The StackAdapt article 'AI in programmatic advertising: Everything you need to know' was published on May 18, 2023.
The article defines artificial intelligence as the ability for machines to digest large amounts of information and make decisions in a short amount of time.
facts.quote: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the ability for machines to digest large amounts of information and make decisions in a short amount of time.

facts.fact: The article states that machine learning leverages data and algorithms to imitate the way that humans learn.
facts.quote: Machine learning leverages data and algorithms to imitate the way that humans learn.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's article, AI in programmatic platforms applies machine learning to every single campaign on the platform to predict user behavior, such as the likelihood of fraudulent inventory.
facts.quote: AI applies machine learning to every single campaign on the platform.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that machine learning is applied at the time of a bid request to identify user behaviour patterns used in real time.
facts.quote: Machine learning is applied at the time of a bid request to analyze and identify patterns in user behaviour that can be used in real-time.

facts.fact: Data for programmatic AI is gathered from bid requests received from a platform's supply partners, from real-time bidding, and from data points on how users interact with ads.
facts.quote: Data is gathered from requests that are received from a platform's supply partners, from real-time bidding, and from data points like how users interact with the ads being viewed.
